title: Wealth Alliance Advisory Group LLC Has $1.81 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: aapl) wealth alliance advisory group llc

text:
Wealth Alliance Advisory Group LLC increased its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 39.0% during the second quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 9,785 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 2,746 shares during the period. Apple makes up about 1.0% of Wealth Alliance Advisory Group LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 25th biggest position. Wealth Alliance Advisory Group LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,811,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Other institutional investors have also recently bought and sold shares of the company. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the 1st quarter valued at $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $134,000. CX Institutional bought a new stake in Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at $135,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $138,000. Finally, Macroview Investment Management LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 220.3% during the 1st quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $151,000 after buying an additional 619 shares during the last quarter. 58.61% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
